name: eli5-plus
title_zh: 复杂概念讲给外行听，一页图文化成看得懂的动画
tagline_zh: 直觉、机制、例子、边界，四层拆解全在一张独立网页里。不用专业术语也能让外行点头，适合教学、汇报。
tagline_en: Intuition, mechanism, examples, boundaries—one standalone page. Explain like I'm five, without dumbing down. For.
desc_en: Create accurate visual explainers for non-specialists, covering intuition, mechanisms, examples, and boundaries in a standalone HTML page. Use when the user invokes ELI5+ (including $eli5-plus where supported) or asks to truly understand a complex topic through diagrams, examples, or meaningful animation. Not for ultra-brief summaries or expert-first technical deep dives.
why_zh: 它把「懂」拆成四个可检验的层次，每层配图配动画，逼你补上自己都没意识到的漏洞。不是简化。
why_en: It forces understanding into four testable layers—intuition, mechanism, examples, limits—each with visuals. Not simplification.
limit_zh: 只认需要可视化拆解的复杂主题；极简摘要、纯文字问答、专家级技术深挖它不接。产物是独立 HTML。
limit_en: Only for complex topics needing visual breakdown. No ultra-brief summaries, text-only Q&A, or expert deep dives. Output is a standalone HTML—no.
title_en: Complex topics as one-page visual explainers with animation
